projects.title: Our Projects
projects.subtitle: A showcase of our precision and expertise in various surveying and engineering projects.

items.title: Land Surveying Project
items.description: Comprehensive land surveying for a new residential development.
details: Precise boundary identification using high-accuracy GPS.
Creation of detailed topographic maps for site planning.
Legal documentation and certification for land registration.
Coordination with local authorities for regulatory compliance.
Implementation of modern GIS data for long-term management.

items.title: Road Infrastructure Mapping
items.description: Precise grid leveling and mapping for a major highway project.
details: High-precision grid leveling for road design and grading.
Alignment and staking of road centerlines and boundaries.
Volume calculations for earthwork and material estimation.
Real-time monitoring of construction progress using Total Station.
As-built surveys to verify compliance with engineering designs.

items.title: Urban Planning GIS
items.description: Spatial data analysis and mapping for urban expansion planning.
details: Integration of multi-source spatial data into a unified GIS.
Analysis of urban growth patterns and land use suitability.
Creation of interactive digital maps for urban planners.
Infrastructure network planning including water and power lines.
Environmental impact assessment using spatial modeling.

items.title: Coastal Boundary Definition
items.description: Legal boundary definition for coastal resorts in the Red Sea.
details: Accurate measurement of high-water marks and shoreline changes.
Definition of legal boundaries for private and public zones.
Resolution of boundary overlaps and property disputes.
Preparation of certified cadastral maps for resort development.
Consultation on environmental regulations for coastal construction.
